en: Monochrome printed postcard showing a round stone tower with a conical roof, standing on a small rise in a park‑like landscape. Bare trees with twisted branches dominate the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter. A path curves around the hill and a few small human figures walk along it. The scene has a slightly dramatic, artistic rendering rather than a straightforward photograph. There is a small handwritten archival code along the lower edge outside the image area.
